Hi Sam —

Appreciate you sending these over. A couple of internal checks before we can clear the PO: 
- We need either (A) a notarized signatory letter (scan is usually acceptable if the notary stamp is clear) or (B) an apostille if the company is foreign-incorporated (not the case here).
- The W-8BEN-E must include the EIN and a printed name matching the signer on the authority letter.

Rachel — can you confirm whether the scan and notary-stamp on their authority letter meet our finance compliance threshold for conditional PO activation? If yes, we can provision a conditional PO (limited amount) while originals are sent. If no, we'll request an original notarized copy.

Sam — if you can provide a short corporate attestation email (one-line) from your legal or contracts team confirming Maria Chen is CFO and authorized to sign, that'll help speed things up.

Thanks,
